sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and come into this fixture on the back of a win, with excellent recent form of five wins and a draw from their last six. Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in desperately poor form, having won only once in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, with only 2 points separating them from Sandbach at the summit. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in what shapes as a competitive midtable clash. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a match between two mid-table sides, while fellow contenders Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a clash between lower midtable teams chasing momentum. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at the bottom of the pile, where points are needed urgently on both sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a basement battle with minimal separation. Crewe host Allscott Heath as both teams seek to climb away from the lower reaches. Shawbury United host Barnton in a fixture between two struggling sides, with Barnton's recent upturn making them the form team in this encounter.
